title: LO evidence navigator and cleaner recording layout
details: Evidence packages now use one local ZIP selection instead of trying to open neighbouring video files that phones and desktop browsers can block
The evidence viewer now lists Introduction, each recorded learning outcome and Witness testimony as clear sections, with AC timestamps inside the selected section
On phones the evidence video stays fixed at the top while LO and AC sections scroll underneath
The extra minus 10 seconds, plus 10 seconds, manual timestamp box and Go to timestamp controls are removed from the visible viewer because AC timestamps now provide direct navigation
The live Milos recording screen now puts the camera first, the full AC directly underneath, then competence controls and Next AC, removing the unused black space below square video
Existing MP4 fast-start repair, WebM duration repair, original media quality and complete evidence ZIP export remain unchanged
